Jwt.//: DEVELOPMENT PLACEHOLDER ONLY. In production this MUST be replaced with a managed secret (Key Vault / user-secrets / env var) and NEVER committed.

WebAuthn.//: RelyingPartyId/Origins must match the Web(.Client) host the browser actually loads the page from, not this Api.

Email.//: DEVELOPMENT PLACEHOLDER ONLY. SmtpUsername/SmtpPassword must never be committed for a real account — use user-secrets/env var, same rule as Jwt:SigningKey. Left empty here: with SmtpHost empty, DI falls back to LoggingEmailSender so local dev works without any SMTP account configured.
